title: 第三章 残值 六万金币第四章 196°C的傲慢
lines: 章节摘要：“小子，你的同情心会害死你。“——牛顿
他们在废土东区找到一个废弃的变电站。
铁皮屋顶，三面墙，一面是豁口。够用。
宁修远把叶清欢扶进去，往地上一坐，右腿“咔哒“了整整五声才安静下来。
叶清欢站在他对面，头微微歪着，眼神在地上、墙上、他脸上来回扫——像一台刚通电的设备，还在校准参数。
“你的右腿义体，型号：灵动3代，停产七年，关节磨损度82%，预计寿命……“她歪头，“不到三天。“
宁修远低头看了一眼——那张皱巴巴的铁丝绑着的纸，已经被机油晕得快认不出字了。
叶清欢的眼中数据流闪过：“欠款：八万金币。债主：铁拳帮。性质：义体分期。起因……“
ui在宁修远视野里悄悄弹出一行字，是她扫描反馈的数据摘要——
[宁修远·义体档案·三年前手术记录]
[备注：手术完成后债务人失联，现由其子代偿]
她只是看着那张付款单，看了很久，然后把视线移开了。
她胸口的能源核心指示灯，从绿色变成了黄色。
宁修远注意到了，抬眼：“怎么了？“
叶清欢低头看了一眼自己的胸口，语气平静，像在汇报天气：
“行，我去找充电的东西——“宁修远刚想站起来。
叶清欢歪了歪头，看着他，眼神里没有恐惧，没有慌乱——就是普通的、陈述事实的平静：
“我的微型聚变核心，市场价约五万金币。“她抬手指了指自己的胸口，“机械躯体的零件，大约还能卖一万。“
content_en:
Chapter Summary: “Boy, your compassion will get you killed.” — Newton
They found an abandoned power substation in the East End of the Wasteland.
Tin roof, three walls, one gap. Enough.
Ning Xiuyuan helped Ye Qinghuan in and sat on the ground. His right leg clicked five times before he became quiet.
Ye Qinghuan stood opposite him, his head tilted slightly, his eyes scanning back and forth on the ground, the wall, and his face - like a newly powered device still calibrating its parameters.
"What are you sweeping?" Ning Xiuyuan asked.
"Environment." She paused, "And you."
"What was swept out?"
"Your right leg prosthesis, model: Smart 3rd generation, has been out of production for seven years, the joint wear is 82%, and its estimated lifespan..." She tilted her head, "less than three days."
"I know."
"You have a payment slip on your wrist."
Ning Xiuyuan glanced down - the crumpled piece of paper tied with wire was so dizzy from the engine oil that he could hardly read the words.
A stream of data flashed through Ye Qinghuan's eyes: "Arrearage: 80,000 gold coins. Creditor: Iron Fist Gang. Nature: Prosthetic body installment. Cause..."
She stopped.
UI quietly popped up a line of text in Ning Xiuyuan's field of vision, which was a summary of the data she scanned and fed back——
[Ning Xiuyuan·Prosthetic Body Archives·Surgery Records Three Years Ago]
[Payee: Ning Jianguo (deceased)]
[Note: The debtor lost contact after the operation was completed, and his son is now responsible for the compensation]
Ye Qinghuan didn't say any more.
She just looked at the payment slip, looked at it for a long time, and then looked away.
There was silence for about three minutes.
The energy core indicator light on her chest changed from green to yellow.
Ning Xiuyuan noticed it and raised his eyes: "What's wrong?"
Ye Qinghuan glanced down at his chest and spoke calmly, as if reporting the weather:
"Energy margin: 3%."
[Warning·Energy critical]
[Estimated duration: 51 minutes]
[Recommendation: Shut down non-essential systems immediately]
[Or: Find charging source]
"Okay, I'll go find something to charge -" Ning Xiuyuan was about to stand up.
"No need."
He paused.
Ye Qinghuan tilted his head and looked at him. There was no fear or panic in his eyes - just the ordinary calmness of stating the facts:
"Ning Xiuyuan, I have a proposal."
"Say."
"The market price of my micro fusion core is about 50,000 gold coins." She raised her finger and pointed at her chest, "The parts of the mechanical body can be sold for about 10,000 gold coins."
"A total of sixty thousand gold coins."
title_en: Chapter 3 Residual value 60,000 gold coins Chapter 4 Arrogance at 196°C
